en: They stood firm when others fled! A hero's hallmark!

en: Their war record reads like a heroic ballad!

en: Honour like theirs is rarer than a legendary drop!

en: They've made their faction proud and their rivals pale!

en: The battle is won, the rank is earned, the tears are flowing!

en: A champion's honour! A champion's heart! A champion's rank!
nn: Ei meisterære! Eit meisterhjarte! Ein meistergrad!

en: The enemy faction has started calling them a legend! Grudgingly!
nn: Fiendefraksjonen har byrja å kalle dei ei legende! Motvillig!

en: Their bravery deserves a statue in every capital!

en: The battlegrounds will remember their name with awe!

en: I'm so excited I've polished every shield in the house!

en: Their honour has broken records and hearts!
nn: Æra deira har slått rekordar og knust hjarte!

en: A milestone of glory! The faction sings!

en: They've stormed the battlefield and my heart!

en: Their courage turned the tide and turned my head!

en: Every honour point is a medal on my heart!

en: The battlefield has never seen such dramatic heroism!

en: They've made the enemy faction reconsider its life choices!
nn: Dei har fått fiendefraksjonen til å tenkje gjennom livsvala sine!

en: It seems their honour is now measured in legends!

en: A battle-worn hero with a shining rank!
nn: Ein krigsslitt helt med ein skinande grad!

en: Their honour is a beacon to their whole faction!
nn: Æra deira er ein varde for heile fraksjonen!

en: I'm waving my sword! It's a butter knife! It's symbolic!
nn: Eg viftar med sverdet! Det er ein smørkniv! Det er symbolsk!

en: They've climbed to new heights of honour! The view is glorious!
nn: Dei har klatra til nye æreshøgder! Utsikta er strålande!

en: The enemy fled, the honour stayed, and I wept!
nn: Fienden flykta, æra vart verande, og eg gret!

en: Their bravery has filled the war chronicles with drama!
nn: Tapperheita deira har fylt krigskrønikene med drama!

en: A milestone in the art of war! I'm dazzled!
nn: Ein milepæl i krigskunsten! Eg er blenda!

en: They've fought their way into the history books!

en: The honour is theirs! The glory is theirs! My tears are theirs!

en: Their valour echoes across every battleground!
nn: Tapperheita deira ljomar over kvar slagmark!

en: A new rank in the ranks of heroes!

en: The war is long, but their honour is longer!

en: They've earned a rank that sparkles with valour!

en: Duel after duel, they refused to yield! I refuse to stop crying!

en: The rival faction's bards are writing tragedies about them!

en: That honour was hard-won and it shows! Gloriously!
nn: Den æra var hardt tent, og det syner! Strålande!

en: I flinched at every crit! I cheered at every win!
nn: Eg rykte til ved kvart kritisk treff! Eg jubla ved kvar siger!

en: Their war paint is now a badge of honour!
nn: Krigsmålinga deira er no eit æresmerke!

en: The battlefield crowned them and I curtsied!
nn: Slagmarka krona dei, og eg neia!

en: They came for honour and left with a legend!
nn: Dei kom for æra og drog med ei legende!

en: The trumpets of war have a brand-new favourite tune!

en: That rank is a triumph of nerves, skill and sheer drama!

en: Somewhere, an enemy is practising their dodge just for them!

en: I kept a tally of their victories! The paper ran out!

en: Their honour is the plot twist the other faction dreaded!

en: The battle standard bears their glory now!
nn: Stridsbanneret ber æra deira no!

en: They faced the storm of battle and became the storm!
nn: Dei møtte stridsstormen og vart stormen!

en: A rank worthy of a hero's welcome home!
nn: Ein grad verdig ei heltemottaking heime!

en: I've rehearsed a victory speech for them! It's very loud!
nn: Eg har øvd på ein sigerstale for dei! Han er svært høglydt!

en: Their glory on the field has me swooning in the stands!
nn: Æra deira på slagmarka får meg til å svime på tribunen!

en: The honour they've gathered would make a king blush!
nn: Æra dei har samla, ville ha fått ein konge til å raudme!

en: They stood in the thick of it and never backed down!
nn: Dei stod midt i det og gav seg aldri!

en: That milestone deserves a cannon salute! Boom!

en: I'm sobbing into my war bonds! I don't have war bonds!

en: They've made every battleground a theatre of triumph!
nn: Dei har gjort kvar slagmark til eit triumfteater!

en: Their opponents will need a long rest after that!

en: Honour! Glory! Rank! Tissues! In that order!
nn: Ære! Herlegdom! Grad! Lommetørkle! I den rekkjefølgja!

en: The war council's quills are trembling with excitement!
nn: Fjørpennene i krigsrådet skjelv av spenning!

en: I'd follow them into any battle! Well, behind them! Far behind!
nn: Eg ville følgje dei inn i kva kamp som helst! Vel, bak dei! Langt bak!

en: Every bruise, every scar, every victory led to this!
nn: Kvart blåmerke, kvart arr, kvar siger førte hit!

en: Their fame on the battlefield spreads like wildfire!

en: The fiercest opponents now step aside respectfully!

en: I've added a war medal to my emotional support collection!

en: They didn't just survive the battle! They owned it!
nn: Dei overlevde ikkje berre kampen! Dei eigde han!

en: A warrior's milestone! The pride! The swagger! The sobbing!
nn: Ein krigarmilepæl! Stoltheita! Sjølvtilliten! Hulkinga!

en: The scoreboard just became their trophy wall!

en: Their honour rings out louder than any war horn!
nn: Æra deira ljomar høgare enn noko krigshorn!

en: That rank was forged in the fires of fierce competition!
nn: Den graden vart smidd i elden frå hard konkurranse!
